title: xAI Colossus - the Gulf/Nvidia-financed GPU buildout + the Memphis gas-turbine fight
source: Public record: Bloomberg/TechCrunch/DCD/E&E on the $20B round + SPV; SELC/Earthjustice + NAACP litigation filings; Shelby County / Mississippi permit actions. Structural overlay (no financial-core edges; dollar figures in notes). HONESTY: the round, SPV structure, and turbine/permit facts = documented (private co -> debt/equity splits are press-reported; turbine counts are point-in-time + differ by site); the NAACP/Earthjustice suit = allegations, ONGOING (not final findings); 'circular financing' + the permit-timing juxtaposition = interpretation, no causation asserted.
grade: per-edge in notes (fact | reported | contested/ongoing | interpretation)

edges.notes: xAI's Colossus supercomputer sites (Colossus 1, Memphis TN; Colossus 2, Southaven MS) are funded by its ~$20B round (closed Jan 2026, ~$230B valuation): reportedly ~$7.5B equity + ~$12.5B debt routed through an SPV that BUYS Nvidia GPUs and rents them to xAI. Nvidia put ~$2B equity into a vehicle buying Nvidia's own chips - a circular supplier-funds-buyer loop (fact of round; splits reported; circular framing interpretation). xAI reportedly burns ~$1B/month.

Colossus is powered by on-site methane turbines: Colossus 1 ran ~35 turbines (~421MW) for over a year before a Jul-2025 permit (for 15); Colossus 2 (Southaven) ran ~57-59 turbines, with 40-90 planned for up to ~1.5GW - far above initial consumption (fact; counts point-in-time + vary by source).

Behind-the-meter self-generation lets xAI sidestep the grid-interconnection queue - the AI-power-bottleneck workaround that also moves emissions off the utility's books and onto the datacenter (fact of approach; interpretation of the trade-off).

Colossus is among the largest single AI training clusters; its gas-first power model is a template other AI buildouts may copy where grid power is unavailable fast enough (fact of scale; template framing interpretation).

The NAACP + Mississippi State Conference NAACP (represented by Earthjustice + SELC) sued xAI + subsidiary MZX Tech over unpermitted methane turbines powering Colossus 2 in Southaven - alleging Clean Air Act violations with potential to emit ~1,700 tons/yr NOx plus PM, CO, and formaldehyde, sited near predominantly Black communities (an environmental-justice claim). A permit issued ~one week after an xAI official discussed the site with President Trump; environmental groups called the process rushed (fact of suit + allegations + timing; ONGOING - no final finding; no causation asserted on the permit timing).

xAI's ~$12.5B GPU-SPV debt + ~$1B/month burn put it in the same debt-funded-AI-capex cohort as the neocloud wall (CoreWeave/Oracle) + the Meta/Blue Owl SPV template - private, unrated, and dependent on continued mega-rounds to service the buildout (fact of structure; risk-cohort framing interpretation).
